rows.OriginalDescription: Damage to Barbarians +{p1}%.

rows.Name: Wall Razer
rows.ResolvedDescription: Enemy building and siege equipment Durability Reduction Speed +15%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Enemy building and siege equipment Durability Reduction Speed +{p1}%.

rows.Name: Hold the Line
rows.ResolvedDescription: Damage taken while fighting on walls -10%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Damage taken while fighting on walls -{p1}%.

rows.Name: Armored Assault
rows.ResolvedDescription: Damage taken while reducing enemy building Durability -10%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Damage taken while reducing enemy building Durability -{p1}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME5
rows.Name: Advancing Aquila
rows.ResolvedDescription: Damage dealt while fighting in Civitates +15%, and +5% extra while in ranged mode.
rows.OriginalDescription: Damage dealt while fighting in Civitates +{p1}%, and +{p2}% extra while in ranged mode.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME6
rows.Name: Siege & Counter
rows.ResolvedDescription: While reducing enemy building and siege equipment Durability, counterattack damage +50%.
rows.OriginalDescription: While reducing enemy building and siege equipment Durability, counterattack damage +{p1}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME7
rows.Name: Weathered Troops
rows.ResolvedDescription:
While fighting in Civitates, field damage +0.2% for every 500000 Barbarian units killed (for up to 5%).
(Obtained buffs will continue to take effect after this strategy is reset)
rows.OriginalDescription: While fighting in Civitates, field damage +{p2}% for every {p1} Barbarian units killed (for up to {p3}%). (Obtained buffs will continue to take effect after this strategy is reset)

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME8
rows.Name: Quick Retreat
rows.ResolvedDescription: Routed troop March Speed +200%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Routed troop March Speed +{p1}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME9
rows.Name: Seize & Conquer
rows.ResolvedDescription: Severely wounding or killing enemy units will earn you rewards, including resource items. You can earn up to 10000000 of each type of resource per day.
rows.OriginalDescription: Severely wounding or killing enemy units will earn you rewards, including resource items. You can earn up to {p1} of each type of resource per day.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME10
rows.Name: Unfading Oath
rows.ResolvedDescription: Damage taken -7% for field troops, but 1% of severely wounded units will immediately die.
rows.OriginalDescription: Damage taken -{p1}% for field troops, but {p2}% of severely wounded units will immediately die.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME11
rows.Name: Tight Pursuit
rows.ResolvedDescription: Every normal attack launched has a 10% chance to -10% March Speed for the target troop. This effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts 3 seconds.
rows.OriginalDescription: Every normal attack launched has a {p1}% chance to -{p2}% March Speed for the target troop. This effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts 3 seconds.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME12
rows.Name: Warrior's Spirit
rows.ResolvedDescription: Damage dealt +1% for every 400000 killed Tier 5 troops recorded in the Hall of Heroes, for up to 5%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Damage dealt +{p2}% for every {p1} killed Tier 5 troops recorded in the Hall of Heroes, for up to {p3}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME13
rows.Name: No Return
rows.ResolvedDescription: Every normal attack launched has a 3% chance to cause the target troop to enter a 3-second frenzy, during which they cannot enter cities.
rows.OriginalDescription: Every normal attack launched has a {p1}% chance to cause the target troop to enter a 3-second frenzy, during which they cannot enter cities.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME14
rows.Name: Counter Strike
rows.ResolvedDescription: For every 300000 severely wounded units you own, counterattack damage on the map +2%, for up to 20%. This effect lasts 3 hours and its duration resets whenever it gains another stack.
rows.OriginalDescription: For every {p1} severely wounded units you own, counterattack damage on the map +{p2}%, for up to {p3}%. This effect lasts 3 hours and its duration resets whenever it gains another stack.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME15
rows.Name: Delayed Success
rows.ResolvedDescription: Gathering Speed -50%, but Gathered Resources +25% (not applicable to Gem Deposits).
rows.OriginalDescription: Gathering Speed -{p1}%, but Gathered Resources +{p2}% (not applicable to Gem Deposits).

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME16
rows.Name: Healing Touch
rows.ResolvedDescription: Reduces resource cost of healing units by 10%. You can save up to 700000000 resources this way per Season.
rows.OriginalDescription: Reduces resource cost of healing units by {p1}%. You can save up to {p2} resources this way per Season.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME17
rows.Name: Booming Gains
rows.ResolvedDescription: Gain an additional 5% of resources when Gathering ends (not applicable to Gem Deposits).
rows.OriginalDescription: Gain an additional {p1}% of resources when Gathering ends (not applicable to Gem Deposits).

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME18
rows.Name: Field Medic
rows.ResolvedDescription: Hospital Capacity +30%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Hospital Capacity +{p1}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME19
rows.Name: Fort Breacher
rows.ResolvedDescription:
For each Barbarian Fort you destroy, Troop March Speed +0.1%, for up to 5%. Resets every Monday.
(Obtained buffs will continue to take effect after this strategy is reset)
rows.OriginalDescription: For each Barbarian Fort you destroy, Troop March Speed +{p1}%, for up to {p2}%. Resets every Monday. (Obtained buffs will continue to take effect after this strategy is reset)

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME20
rows.Name: Swift Soar
rows.ResolvedDescription: Troop March Speed +5%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Troop March Speed +{p1}%.

rows.Title: LC_KINGDOMWAR_S22_TALENT_NAME21
rows.Name: Glorious Return
rows.ResolvedDescription: Increases the proportion of units resurrected by the Hall of Heroes at the end of the season by 3%.
rows.OriginalDescription: Increases the proportion of units resurrected by the Hall of Heroes at the end of the season by {p1}%.
